However, it can be associated with the concept of a religious friar or brother, often abbreviated as "F.R." or "Fray." This title represents a commitment to a life devoted to religious service, and the name may conjure images of piety, spirituality, and devotion.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Frayne" lies in its potential connection to the word "fragrance." In Christian theology, believers are called to be the "aroma of Christ" to the world around them (2 Corinthians 2:15). Just as fragrance rises from a flower and fills a room, so too can Christians spread the love and grace of Christ wherever they go. The name "Frayne," therefore, serves as a reminder to carry the fragrance of God with us in our daily lives and to share His love with others.
